findings.finding: A $3m senior secured convertible note issued 2026-09-28 (filed 2026-09-29) is convertible now at the lesser of $7.30 or 90% of the lowest 10-day VWAP (floor $1.46), with a 4.99% ownership cap and no price-drop default. That puts conversion shares at or below the $4.22 spot in the hands of a holder that has sold down this name through two ADS consolidations. The notes' quarterly interest date is 2026-10-01, payable in ADSs at 90% of the 5-day VWAP if the company elects.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The note is convertible immediately and there is no lock-up in the exhibit. The 10-day VWAP lookback now includes the 09-28/09-29 lows, so the conversion price is at or below spot tomorrow. The Oct 1 interest date falls inside the window, and ADS interest shares can be issued and sold that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The baseline shows -92.5% over 60 sessions and -55.5% over 20 in a name with a toxic-structure note facility (the June 2025 $600m ATW agreement, same terms) and ADS ratio changes on 2026-07-14 and 2026-09-10. Of the eight comparable falls since 09-15, four were followed by another large down close (-20.5%, -7.9%, -22.0%, -6.4%). The other four bounced, so the history is two-sided.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's fade from $6.6 to $4.22 cleared the morning's pump, so the stock is only 6% below yesterday's close. That is about the size of the prior day's ordinary move, and a price that held fresh below-spot conversion supply would not sit at yesterday's level. After a pump day, tomorrow's bid returns toward the $0.39m-a-day median turnover. Against that, 750k-ish conversion ADS ($3m at about $4) is many days of normal volume, and the price has not taken that.
findings.independence: The June 2025 $600m convertible facility with ATW, on the same terms, is the source of the repeated dilution: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1806524/000121390025055423/ea0246122-6k_lion.htm.
